name: Chordclaw
mechanics: Deals four hits of Direct damage to an adjacent enemy.
Exitor-Rho's further attacks gain two additional Direct-damage hits until the end of his next turn.
breakpoint_notes: Value rises when friendly Mechanical attacks can trigger multiple further Exitor-Rho attacks during the effect window.
